theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_rps_support_subset_closure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G M : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ G → T ω = m * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → T.support ∩ G ⊆ closure M
